The image shows a rose gold Audemars Piguet Royal Oak with blue dial, date at 3 o'clock, integrated gold bracelet. This is the Royal Oak Jumbo Extra-Thin 16202OR.OO.1240OR.01? Or the 15400OR? Let's think.

The dial appears blue with "Grande Tapisserie" pattern, only "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied at 12 (the AP logo is above, but here it reads "AUDEMARS PIGUET" in gold). Actually the newer 16202 has the AP monogram? The 15500OR.OO.1220OR.01 has blue dial with "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied signature. The 15510OR.OO.1320OR.01 also.

Royal Oak 41mm rose gold with blue dial: ref 15500OR.OO.1220OR.01 (discontinued 2021/2022), succeeded by 15510OR.OO.1320OR.01. Also 15400OR.OO.1220OR.03 blue dial existed (2012-ish with AP logo? no).

The dial here: "AUDEMARS PIGUET" in gold applied, no AP monogram above. The 15500 has that. The 15400 also had AP monogram plus Audemars Piguet? Actually 15400 has AP monogram applied above "Audemars Piguet"? Let me recall: 15400 dial: applied "AP" logo at 12 and "Audemars Piguet" printed? Actually the 15202 has AP monogram at 12 and "Audemars Piguet" printed at 12 below? Hmm.

The Royal Oak 15400 dial: "Audemars Piguet" logo (AP monogram) applied at 12, and "Audemars Piguet" printed? I think the 15400 has the applied AP monogram at 12 o'clock and "Audemars Piguet" in print above or below. The 15500 dropped the monogram and has "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied in gold letters. Yes — the 15500 replaced the AP monogram with applied "Audemars Piguet" signature.

So this is a 15500OR.OO.1220OR.01, Royal Oak Selfwinding 41mm pink gold with blue dial. But the successor 15510OR... both have same dial style. Hmm, the 15510 has slightly different: date window, and the dial "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied. Hard to distinguish. The 15510ST blue dial 15510ST.OO.1320ST.06.

Hmm, the big difference: 15500 has the date aperture and "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied, 15510 also. The 15510's dial has a slightly different text placement and the case back. From the front, hard.

Given the photo is likely a product stock photo, likely of the 15500OR.OO.1220OR.01, which is the well-known "Royal Oak 41 rose gold blue dial". Actually there's also 15400OR.OO.1220OR.03 with blue dial — no, 15400OR.OO.1220OR.03 is... The 15400 blue dial reference is 15400OR.OO.1220OR.03? Hmm, 15400's blue dial was 15400OR.OO.1220OR.03? I recall 15400ST.OO.1220ST.03 was blue steel dial? Actually blue dial steel 15400ST.OO.1220ST.03? Hmm not sure. 15400OR.OO.1220OR.03 seems plausible as rose gold blue.

Which one does the photo show? The dial has "AUDEMARS PIGUET" written in gold applied letters (not the AP monogram). Distinguishing 15400 vs 15500: 15400 has AP monogram applied at 12 with "Audemars Piguet" printed below. Let me verify: The Royal Oak 15400 dial: at 12 there's the applied AP logo (monogram) and below it "AUDEMARS PIGUET" printed text? I believe the 15400 has "Audemars Piguet" printed under the AP applied logo. Hmm.

Actually, looking at photos: Royal Oak 15400ST — dial shows the AP monogram at 12 with "AUDEMARS PIGUET" printed in small letters below? Or it just shows "Audemars Piguet" and "Genève"? I recall the 15400 dial has applied AP monogram and "Audemars Piguet" printed beneath. The 15500 has only applied "Audemars Piguet" letters and "SWISS MADE" at 6. The 15202 has AP monogram applied and "Audemars Piguet" printed.

In this photo, I see "AUDEMARS PIGUET" in what appears to be applied gold letters, no monogram. So 15500OR.OO.1220OR.01 (or 15510OR.OO.1320OR.01).

The image also shows a date window at 3, no AP monogram. The 15500 has applied "AUDEMARS PIGUET" gold logo. Yes.

I'll go with 15500OR.OO.1220OR.01, confidence ~0.4.

Actually, could this be a 16202OR (Jumbo)? The Jumbo 16202 has thinner bezel and the dial is a "petite tapisserie"? No, the Jumbo has the "Grande Tapisserie" too... The Jumbo dial blue "Bleu Nuit Nuage 50". Hmm, the 16202OR.OO.1240OR.01 is pink gold Jumbo with blue dial — but sold out limited. The case proportions here look 41mm with the bezel thick; the Jumbo is 39mm with thin bezel and the dial has "Audemars Piguet" applied too? The 16202 has AP monogram at 12 printed? Actually the Jumbo 16202 has "Audemars Piguet" applied in gold? Hmm. The 50th anniversary 16202 has a "50 years" rotor.

Given ambiguity, I'll answer 15500OR.OO.1220OR.01.

Movement: automatic. Case material: gold (rose gold). Bracelet: metal (gold bracelet).

Case material field options: stainless-steel, gold, platinum, titanium, ceramic, bronze, unknown. So "gold". Bracelet: metal.

Confidence 0.4.
